title: Rethinking Memorization Mitigation in Diffusion Models: Reinforcing Text Conditioning
title_zh: 重新思考扩散模型中的记忆化缓解：强化文本条件

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in image synthesis, yet can exhibit memorization by closely reproducing individual training examples. Effective mitigation must preserve useful prompt information to guide alternative depictions. We introduce a training-free method that redistributes cross-attention with Gaussian smoothing before reinforcing content-token contributions and attenuating padding contributions, without additional denoiser evaluations. With this intervention, stronger content conditioning can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity. A local analysis identifies when reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution reduces localized attention mass. On Stable Diffusion v1.4 and v2.0, all evaluated smoothing widths lie on the empirical Pareto frontiers for training-image similarity versus both prompt alignment and image preference. A configuration selected on Stable Diffusion reduces template reproduction in DeepFloyd IF without further tuning. These findings support jointly controlling conditioning allocation and strength to generate prompt-consistent alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像的扩散模型在图像合成方面取得了显著进展，但仍可能通过精确复现单个训练样本而表现出记忆行为。 有效的缓解方法必须保留有用的提示信息，以引导生成替代性描述。 我们提出了一种无需训练的方法，该方法在强化内容标记贡献并减弱填充标记贡献之前，通过高斯平滑重新分配交叉注意力，且无需额外的去噪器评估。 通过这种干预，更强的内容条件化可以在保持与训练图像相似性相当的情况下，提升提示对齐度。 局部分析表明，在何种情况下强化操作能够保留共享的价值信息，同时重新分配操作又能减少局部注意力质量。 在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 和 v2.0 上，所有评估的平滑宽度均位于训练图像相似性与提示对齐度及图像偏好之间的经验帕累托前沿上。 在 Stable Diffusion 上选择的配置能够在不进一步调优的情况下减少 DeepFloyd IF 中的模板复现。 这些发现支持联合控制条件化分配与强度，以生成与提示一致的可替代结果。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image diffusion models enable high-quality image synthesis from natural-language descriptions ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021b ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ) . Yet these models can exhibit memorization : certain prompts elicit close reproductions of individual training images ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Somepalli et al., 2023a ; Somepalli et al., 2023b ; Webster, 2023 ) . Such reproduction can preserve a training image’s distinctive composition and visual details, beyond the semantic resemblance expected from depicting the same subject. Mitigating this behavior requires more than moving the generated image away from a training reference: the model must still produce a useful alternative that follows the prompt. A prompt generally permits many valid depictions, and its objects, attributes, and context provide information for constructing them. Figure 1 illustrates this goal: the film context in the Emma Watson/Belle prompt supports an alternative depiction of the subject.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像的扩散模型能够根据自然语言描述生成高质量图像（Ho 等人，2020；Song 等人，2021b；Rombach 等人，2022；Ramesh 等人，2022；Saharia 等人，2022）。 然而，这些模型可能会表现出记忆效应：某些提示会引发对特定训练图像的近乎精确的复制（Carlini 等人，2023；Somepalli 等人，2023a；Somepalli 等人，2023b；Webster，2023）。 这种复制可能保留训练图像独特的构图和视觉细节，超越了描绘同一主题时预期的语义相似性。 要缓解这种行为，仅将生成的图像与训练参考图像拉开距离是不够的：模型仍需生成一个符合提示的有效替代图像。 一个提示通常允许多种合理的描绘方式，其包含的对象、属性和上下文为构建这些图像提供了信息。 图 1 说明了这一目标：Emma Watson/Belle 提示中的电影背景支持了对该主题的一种替代性描绘。

paragraphs.en: Several inference-time approaches mitigate memorization by weakening or avoiding conditional responses associated with reproduction. Prompt-embedding adjustment reduces the magnitude of text-conditional guidance ( Wen et al., 2024 ) , while initial-noise adjustment seeks starting points with weaker conditional responses and earlier escape from memorization basins ( Han et al., 2025 ) . Other approaches postpone or reverse guidance ( Jain et al., 2025 ) , or reduce attention to prompt words ( Ren et al., 2024 ) . We instead make content reinforcement an active part of mitigation: strengthening useful prompt information to guide alternative depictions.
paragraphs.zh: 多种推理时的方法通过削弱或避免与复现相关的条件响应来减轻记忆效应。 提示嵌入调整降低了文本条件引导的强度（Wen et al., 2024），而初始噪声调整则试图寻找具有较弱条件响应并能更早脱离记忆盆的起点（Han et al., 2025）。 其他方法则延迟或逆转引导（Jain et al., 2025），或减少对提示词的注意力（Ren et al., 2024）。 我们则转而将内容强化作为缓解措施的一个主动环节：加强有用的提示信息，以引导出替代性的描述。

paragraphs.en: We find that content reinforcement can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity. This improvement occurs when content gain is increased with redistribution and padding attenuation held fixed, showing that reinforcement can support useful conditioning during mitigation. We implement this approach as a training-free cross-attention intervention that combines content amplification with Gaussian redistribution and selective padding attenuation. Early smoothing changes the allocation of attention across token positions; amplification then strengthens the redistributed content contributions. The intervention retains the original prompt and frozen model and requires no additional denoiser evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，在训练图像相似度相当的情况下，内容强化能够提升提示对齐效果。 当内容增益增加，而重分布和填充衰减保持不变时，这种改进会出现，这表明强化能够在缓解过程中支持有效的条件约束。 我们将这种方法实现为一种无需训练的交叉注意力干预机制，它将内容增强与高斯重分布及选择性填充衰减相结合。 早期的平滑处理会改变注意力在不同词元位置上的分配；随后，增强操作会强化经过重分布的内容贡献。 该干预机制保留了原始提示和冻结模型，且无需进行额外的去噪器评估。

paragraphs.en: Redistribution improves the suppression–quality balance of this reinforcement strategy. At fixed token gains in our main configuration, Gaussian redistribution recovers prompt alignment and image preference over reweighting alone while retaining most of the suppression. A local analysis complements these generation-level results: under value-coherence conditions, an admissible gain preserves shared feature information while reducing the attention component’s mass on its original token set. Together, these results explain how controlling attention allocation supports reinforcement during mitigation.
paragraphs.zh: 重新分配能够改善该强化策略的抑制–质量平衡。 在我们主配置中，当令牌增益固定时，高斯重新分配相比仅通过重新加权，能够恢复提示对齐和图像偏好，同时保留大部分抑制效果。 局部分析补充了这些生成层面的结果：在价值一致性条件下，一个可接受的增益能够在保留共享特征信息的同时，减少注意力组件对其原始令牌集合的质量分配。 综合来看，这些结果解释了控制注意力分配如何支持缓解过程中的强化。

paragraphs.en: Training-image extraction and replication studies show that diffusion models can reproduce individual training examples ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Somepalli et al., 2023a ) . Data duplication and image–caption associations influence this behavior ( Somepalli et al., 2023b ; Somepalli et al., 2023a ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . Mechanistic analyses locate memorization-related neurons in cross-attention layers ( Hintersdorf et al., 2024 ) , while geometric analyses explain memorization through the relationship between learned and data manifolds ( Ross et al., 2025 ) . Reproduction also takes different forms: Webster (2023) documents both image and template reproduction, and Bright Ending ( Chen et al., 2025 ) examines local memorization in which only part of an image is copied. These perspectives provide complementary accounts of what is reproduced and how memorization is represented in the model.
paragraphs.zh: 训练图像提取与复制研究表明，扩散模型能够重现单个训练样本（Carlini 等人，2023；Somepalli 等人，2023a）。 数据重复以及图像与配文的关联会影响这种行为（Somepalli 等人，2023b；Somepalli 等人，2023a；Chen 等人，2024）。 机制分析将记忆相关的神经元定位在交叉注意力层中（Hintersdorf 等人，2024），而几何分析则通过已学习流形与数据流形之间的关系来解释记忆现象（Ross 等人，2025）。 重现也存在不同形式：Webster（2023）记录了图像和模板两种形式的重现，而 Bright Ending（Chen 等人，2025）则研究了局部记忆现象，即仅复制图像的一部分。 这些视角为“模型中重现了哪些内容”以及“记忆如何被表示”提供了相互补充的解释。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods intervene at different points in generation. Random prompt perturbations disrupt the conditioning associated with reproduction ( Somepalli et al., 2023b ) , while gradient-based prompt adjustment optimizes text embeddings to reduce the magnitude of text-conditional noise predictions ( Wen et al., 2024 ) . Guidance-based methods delay or reverse classifier-free guidance to escape memorization basins ( Jain et al., 2025 ) ; Anti-Memorization Guidance combines guidance terms targeting image duplication, caption duplication, and prompt specificity ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Initial-noise adjustment searches for starting points that permit earlier escape from memorization basins ( Han et al., 2025 ) . Bright Ending ( Chen et al., 2025 ) localizes copied regions using EOS-token attention at the final denoising step and uses the resulting spatial mask to focus detection and prompt optimization on those regions. For direct attention modification, Ren et al. (2024) combine summary-token masking with an increase in the start-of-sequence (SOS) token’s logit before softmax; the latter shifts attention toward SOS and reduces the attention weights assigned to prompt words. Our method instead redistributes attention across token positions before reinforcing content contributions, preserving the original prompt and initial noise without input optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法在生成过程的不同阶段进行干预。 随机提示扰动会破坏与复制相关的条件关联（Somepalli 等，2023b），而基于梯度的提示调整则通过优化文本嵌入来降低文本条件噪声预测的幅度（Wen 等，2024）。 基于引导的方法会延迟或逆转无分类器引导，以摆脱记忆化盆地（Jain 等，2025）；反记忆化引导则结合针对图像重复、标题重复和提示特定性的引导项（Chen 等，2024）。 初始噪声调整方法会寻找能够更早脱离记忆化盆地的起点（Han 等，2025）。 Bright Ending（Chen 等，2025）在最终去噪步骤中利用 EOS 标记注意力定位复制区域，并使用由此生成的空间掩码将检测与提示优化聚焦于这些区域。 对于直接修改注意力的方法，Ren 等 （2024）将摘要标记掩码与在 softmax 前提升序列开始（SOS）标记的 logits 相结合；后者会将注意力向 SOS 转移，并降低分配给提示词的注意力权重。 我们的方法则是在强化内容贡献之前重新分配各标记位置的注意力，从而在不优化输入的前提下保留原始提示和初始噪声。

sents.en: Existing methods intervene at different points in generation.

sents.en: Our method instead redistributes attention across token positions before reinforcing content contributions, preserving the original prompt and initial noise without input optimization.

paragraphs.en: Cross-attention control also supports the expression of prompt semantics. Prompt-to-Prompt ( Hertz et al., 2023 ) reuses attention maps to preserve spatial layout during text-based image editing. Structured Diffusion ( Feng et al., 2023 ) incorporates linguistic structure into cross-attention guidance to improve compositional generation. SynGen ( Rassin et al., 2023 ) uses syntactic relations to align the attention maps of entities and their modifiers, improving attribute binding. Attend-and-Excite ( Chefer et al., 2023 ) addresses neglected subjects by smoothing their spatial attention maps and iteratively optimizing the latent to strengthen their activations. We share the goal of making generated images more faithfully reflect prompt content. Our intervention redistributes attention along token positions and directly amplifies the resulting content contributions, coupling this semantic objective with memorization mitigation rather than optimizing a subject-specific spatial attention objective.
paragraphs.zh: 交叉注意力控制还支持提示语义的表达。 Prompt-to-Prompt（Hertz 等人，2023）通过复用注意力图，在基于文本的图像编辑过程中保留空间布局。 Structured Diffusion（Feng 等人，2023）将语言结构融入交叉注意力引导中，以提升组合生成效果。 SynGen（Rassin 等人，2023）利用句法关系对齐实体与其修饰语的注意力图，从而改善属性绑定。 Attend-and-Excite（Chefer 等人，2023）通过平滑被忽视主体的空间注意力图，并迭代优化潜在表示以增强其激活程度，来解决这一问题。 我们的目标与你们一致，即让生成的图像更忠实地反映提示内容。 我们的干预方法会重新分配各词元位置上的注意力，并直接放大由此产生的内容贡献，将这一语义目标与记忆抑制相结合，而非优化针对特定主体的空间注意力目标。

paragraphs.en: The remaining question is what information survives this redistribution. If neighboring value vectors carry a common feature, the dispersed component can retain that feature even as its token allocation changes. To interpret the retained mass, consider a fixed additive value vector present at every position in the original token set and absent elsewhere. Its contribution from the attention component is proportional to the mass remaining on those positions. The two bounds below thus describe how a shared feature can be preserved while a localized contribution is attenuated. The analysis separates variation in the shared feature from the fraction of mass returned to the original set.
paragraphs.zh: 剩下的问题是，经过这种重新分配后，哪些信息得以保留。 如果相邻的值向量携带一个共同特征，那么即使其标记分配发生变化，分散的组成部分仍然可以保留该特征。 为了理解保留下来的部分，可以考虑一个固定的加性值向量：它在原始标记集的每个位置都存在，而在其他地方则不存在。 它来自注意力部分的贡献与这些位置上保留下来的部分成正比。 因此，以下两个界限描述了在局部贡献被削弱的同时，共享特征如何得以保留。 该分析将共享特征的变化与返回原始集合的质量比例区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Empirical Pareto-frontier performance. In Figure 2 , each of our four operating points lies on the empirical Pareto frontier in both the SSCD–CLIP and SSCD–ImageReward comparisons, on both models: no evaluated alternative improves one objective without worsening the other. Varying the width traverses this trade-off, with smaller widths favoring quality and larger widths favoring stronger suppression. For example, our method ( σ = 4 \sigma=4 ) and per-sample AIN (target 0.9) both report SSCD 0.2265 on SD v1.4; ours attains higher CLIP (0.2731 versus 0.2647) and ImageReward ( − 0.2374 -0.2374 versus − 0.3522 -0.3522 ). Against the attention-based CS baseline, our σ = 1 \sigma=1 setting attains lower SSCD and higher CLIP than every evaluated CS setting on both models. On SD v2.0, it also achieves higher ImageReward.
paragraphs.zh: 经验帕累托前沿性能。 在图 2 中，我们的四个运行点中的每一个都位于 SSCD–CLIP 和 SSCD–ImageReward 比较中的经验帕累托前沿上，且适用于两种模型：没有任何被评估的替代方案能在不恶化一个目标的情况下改善另一个目标。 改变宽度会遍历这种权衡关系，较小的宽度更倾向于质量，而较大的宽度则更倾向于更强的抑制效果。 例如，我们的方法（σ = 4 \sigma=4）和每个样本的 AIN（目标 0.9）在 SD v1.4 上都报告了 0.2265 的 SSCD；我们的方法实现了更高的 CLIP（0.2731 对比 0.2647）和 ImageReward（−0.2374 -0.2374 对比 −0.3522 -0.3522）。 与基于注意力的 CS 基线相比，我们的 σ = 1 \sigma=1 设置在两种模型上都实现了比所有被评估的 CS 设置更低的 SSCD 和更高的 CLIP。 在 SD v2.0 上，它还实现了更高的 ImageReward。

paragraphs.en: With Gaussian redistribution and padding suppression retained, λ w = 2 \lambda_{w}=2 yields higher CLIP than λ w = 1 \lambda_{w}=1 at comparable SSCD, as shown in Figure 4 . This improvement shows that stronger content conditioning can support prompt alignment without undoing the achieved suppression. Between these endpoints, SSCD responds non-monotonically: it first rises and then falls back to a comparable level at gain 2, while the wider sweep to 3 extends this decline. In the accompanying example, at λ w = 1 \lambda_{w}=1 the pillow is blue but the guitar is brown; at λ w = 2 \lambda_{w}=2 , the guitar itself is blue, matching the requested attribute. These observations support reinforcement as a means of expressing useful prompt information during mitigation, without uniformly strengthening reproduction of the training reference. This generation-level behavior complements the local compatibility result in Eq. ( 8 ), which identifies when reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution reduces localized attention mass.
paragraphs.zh: 在保留高斯重分布和填充抑制的情况下，当 λ w = 2 \lambda_{w}=2 时，与 λ w = 1 \lambda_{w}=1 相比，在相似的 SSCD 水平下，CLIP 得分更高，如图 4 所示。这种改进表明，更强的内容条件化可以在不抵消已实现的抑制效果的前提下，支持提示对齐。在这两个端点之间，SSCD 的响应并非单调的：它先上升，然后在增益为 2 时回落至相似水平；而将增益进一步扩展到 3 时，这种下降趋势会持续更久。在附带的示例中，当 λ w = 1 \lambda_{w}=1 时，枕头是蓝色的，但吉他却是棕色的；而当 λ w = 2 \lambda_{w}=2 时，吉他本身变成了蓝色，与所请求的属性一致。这些观察结果支持将强化视为一种在缓解过程中表达有用提示信息的方法，而不会均匀地加强训练参考的再现。这种生成层级的行为补充了公式 (8) 中的局部兼容性结果，该结果表明：当强化能够保留共享的价值信息，同时重分布减少局部注意力质量时，就会出现这种情况。

paragraphs.en: Content reinforcement and selective suppression play complementary roles. Together, the quantitative trade-off and the qualitative change motivate treating the first EOS separately from the padding span.

paragraphs.en: We test whether our SD-selected configuration transfers to T5-conditioned, pixel-space IF without target-specific tuning. Using template annotations ( Webster, 2023 ) , we evaluate 48 template-verbatim (TV) prompts across 11 shared-reference groups and three seeds (144 images per arm). As shown in Table 3 , our method reduces template matches from 38.89% to 20.14%. This reduction under the SD-selected settings shows that the intervention can suppress reproduction with a different text encoder and generation space. CLIP and ImageReward also decrease relative to the base model, so the transferred configuration retains a suppression benefit with a quality cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测试了通过SD选择的配置能否在没有针对特定目标进行调优的情况下，迁移到以T5为条件、基于像素空间的IF中。 我们使用模板标注（Webster, 2023），在11个共享参考组和三个种子（每个分支144张图像）上评估了48个逐字复制模板（TV）的提示。 如表3所示，我们的方法将模板匹配率从38.89%降低到了20.14%。 在SD选择的设置下，这种降低表明该干预措施能够抑制使用不同文本编码器和生成空间时的重复生成。 CLIP和ImageReward相对于基础模型也有所下降，因此迁移后的配置在带来质量损失的同时，仍保留了一定的抑制效果。

paragraphs.en: To limit intervention on ordinary prompts, we intervene at full strength ( σ = 4 \sigma=4 ) only on inputs flagged by the initial-step guidance detector of Wen et al. (2024) . At a calibrated 5% false-positive rate, mean SSCD on 500 memorized prompts falls from 0.5486 to 0.3475, versus 0.2078 when every prompt is treated. Because unflagged inputs follow the original generation path, selective application preserves most normal generations while still reducing reproduction. paragraphs.en: We show that stronger content conditioning within redistributed attention can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity, making reinforcement an active means of generating useful alternatives during mitigation. The local analysis identifies conditions under which reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution dilutes localized attention, and controlled comparisons show quality recovery from redistribution at fixed token gains. Our method attains empirical Pareto-frontier performance on two Stable Diffusion benchmarks. An SD-selected configuration also reduces template reproduction in DeepFloyd IF without further tuning. The resulting principle is to reinforce useful prompt content during mitigation, using redistribution to improve the balance between reproduction suppression and prompt-consistent generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，在重新分配的注意力机制中引入更强的内容条件约束，可以在保持训练图像相似性相当的情况下提升提示对齐效果，从而使强化学习成为缓解过程中生成有效替代方案的一种主动手段。 局部分析确定了强化学习在何种条件下能够保留共享的价值信息，而重新分配则会削弱局部注意力；受控比较表明，在固定令牌增益的情况下，重新分配能够恢复生成质量。 我们的方法在两个 Stable Diffusion 基准测试中实现了经验上的帕累托前沿性能。 一种通过 SD 选择的配置还能在不进行额外调优的情况下减少 DeepFloyd IF 中的模板重复生成。 由此得出的原则是：在缓解过程中强化有用的提示内容，并利用重新分配来平衡模板抑制与提示一致性生成之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: The controlled SD studies use DDIM ( Song et al., 2021a ) with 50 steps, CFG scale 7, and 512 × 512 512\times 512 outputs. Redistribution and guidance controls use a common 340-prompt subset of the 500-prompt benchmark, comprising 264 template-memorization (TM) and 76 verbatim-memorization (VM) prompts. The subset is stratified by memorization type, with identical captions and shared recorded ground-truth identifiers kept in the same partition. These controls use two seeds and four images per prompt and seed, with matched initial random draws across settings. Paired SD intervals first average samples and seeds within each prompt, then resample prompts with replacement 10,000 times. A high-similarity batch is defined by at least one of its four images exceeding SSCD 0.5.
paragraphs.zh: 受控的 SD 研究使用 DDIM（Song 等人，2021a），设置 50 步、CFG 缩放值为 7，并生成 512×512 的输出。 再分布和引导控制使用 500 个提示基准中一个常见的 340 提示子集，其中包括 264 个模板记忆（TM）提示和 76 个逐字记忆（VM）提示。 该子集按记忆类型进行分层，其中具有相同标题和共享记录真实值标识符的提示被保留在同一分区中。 这些控制对每个提示和种子使用两个种子和四张图像，并且不同设置之间的初始随机抽取是匹配的。 成对的 SD 区间首先对每个提示内的样本和种子进行平均，然后以放回方式重复采样提示 10,000 次。 高相似性批次被定义为其四张图像中至少有一张的 SSCD 超过 0.5。

Both arms use probability-space Gaussian smoothing without row normalization, λ w = 2 \lambda_{w}=2 , λ p = 0.1 \lambda_{p}=0.1 , and a five-step redistribution window.
